scenarios.name: one RSVP per member per event; other members can still RSVP

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_event_rsvps__events (id, title, event_date, created_by, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO app_event_rsvps__rsvps (id, event_id, member_id, status, guest_count, note, updated_at, visibility) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'yes', 0, '', ?, 'everyone')
INSERT INTO app_event_rsvps__rsvps (id, event_id, member_id, status, guest_count, note, updated_at, visibility) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'no', 0, '', ?, 'everyone')
INSERT INTO app_event_rsvps__rsvps (id, event_id, member_id, status, guest_count, note, updated_at, visibility) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'maybe', 0, '', ?, 'everyone')
SELECT id FROM app_event_rsvps__rsvps WHERE event_id = ?
